assessments.reasoning: The cited rendering of printed p.32 of the digest-matched 3.1a LRM distinguishes informative §4.1 from governing §4.2. The opening paragraph of §4.2 guarantees the contiguous bits representation for a packed array.

challenge.method: Challenge by substituting an unpacked array, a packed array nested in another permitted packed type, and physical storage or external interchange meanings for representation. Check §4.1 versus §4.2 modality.
challenge.results: Section 4.2 expressly leaves unpacked contiguity open and treats a packed array as one vector when it appears as a primary. The guarantee concerns the language representation of packed arrays, including permitted recursive compositions within their own rules.

limitations: Language-level representation is the reviewed scope. Memory allocation, ABI, serialization, synthesis layouts, and later editions require separate authority.
